description: This Java class 'TestSearchUpdaterStream' provides methods to simulate parts of a search updater stream for unit testing purposes. It includes methods to write and delete 'Thing' objects, handling ACLs and metadata, and interacts with MongoDB and Akka Streams.

classes.name: TestSearchUpdaterStream
classes.description: A utility class for running parts of the updater stream in unit tests, allowing writing and deleting 'Thing' objects with optional ACLs and metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TestSearchUpdaterStream with a MongoSearchUpdaterFlow initialized with the provided MongoDatabase.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a 'Thing' object into the updater stream, converting it to JSON, mapping it to a write model, and passing it through the flow.

methods.name: writeThingWithAcl
methods.description: Writes a 'Thing' with an ACL into the updater stream, constructing an Enforcer from the ACL.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a 'Thing' identified by its ID, revision, and policy info from the updater stream.
